2105-4068-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4068-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4068-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2972-8168.description:
Cast Draconic Visitor by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Draconic Visitor enters, Ganax triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
When the Dragon token enters, Ganax triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Repeat step 3.
2972-8168.notes: This combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

997-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 1.

1429-4981-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2438-4986-7896--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Mirkwood Nurturer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mirkwood Nurturer enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Mirkwood Nurturer
Repeat.
2438-4986-7896--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2921-2946-4871-6026.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2921-2946-4871-6026.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-1322-1409-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

5759-6339-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
5759-6339-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Screaming Nemesis indestructible using Rootborn Defenses.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
5759-6339-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

391-757-5904.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

1765-2440-4785-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1765-2440-4785-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

338-560-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-560-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

1409-1449-5921.description:
Activate Plundering Barbarian by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Barbarian enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Plundering Barbarian.
Resolve both Plundering Barbarian triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

955-2366-3512-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
955-2366-3512-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

539-6797-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

2816-6474-6984.notablePrerequisites: The creature with Umbral Mantle attached does not have summoning sickness and has at least twelve charge counters on it. You control at least five creatures.
2816-6474-6984.notes: You can use Evendo, Waking Haven's station ability to put the charge counters on the creature. You can also notably use a Spacecraft for a similar effect.

826-2178-5686-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

437-2757-4222.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Sphinx's Disciple, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3525-4474-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

104-2741-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2741-3197.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-3499-4289-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1690-2538-2585-4908.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
1690-2538-2585-4908.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Grim Monolith to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2538-2585-4908.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

1617-4831-4983-5134-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have enough mana to cast Fated Infatuation.
1617-4831-4983-5134-5358.description:
Cast Fated Infatuation by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-4831-4983-5134-5358.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

2254-4863-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value zero.
2254-4863-5626.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying zero {E}, sacrificing Revolutionist, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Revolutionist's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Revolutionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-3129-4636-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

552-1348-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least six basic Swamps.
552-1348-4657.description:
Declare Magus of the Candelabra as an attacker.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Cabal Stronghold's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, adding {B} for each basic Swamp you control.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and Cabal Stronghold.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

513-1031-4377.description:
Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning up to one nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Walk the Aeons and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Invasion of Arcavios to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3259-4034-4885.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another nontoken creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an additional creature, or have a creature card in your graveyard.
3259-4034-4885.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Yore-Tiller Nephilim as attackers.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Kytheon, Hero of Akros // Gideon, Battle-Forged

488-1293-1414-2232-3103.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
488-1293-1414-2232-3103.description:
Activate Lotus Pedal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Isamaru either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W} and commander tax, if applicable.
Isamaru enters the battlefield, triggering Loran and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Kytheon from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Activate Lotus Pedal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Kytheon by paying {W}.
Kytheon enters the battlefield, triggering Loran and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Isamaru from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Repeat.
